description: Player 1's deck for spec 17's cards-in-play test (SPEC §10.10, R243, R247): #98 Heroic Power (Quickdraw, so it is always in the opening hand, and its text in play is the one power it rolled), #82 KY's Trial (its Discover offers three numbers and no card faces) and #95 Call to Chaos (its rules box reads ??? in play). The other seventeen are 08-do-nothing-a's cards without #55, #66 and #100: every one costs 3 or more and asks nothing, so nothing resolves that the spec does not play. With seed 17-live-48 player 1 opens with Heroic Power, KY's Trial and Call to Chaos in hand on turn 1, with the 1 mana KY's Trial costs.
